# Prepare Images for OCR

> 🤖 *AI Drafted (Not reviewed)*

Normalize image and PDF pages into OCR-ready derived image files without modifying the originals. Applies EXIF rotation, renders PDFs, boosts contrast, and writes prepared JPGs for downstream transcription workflows.
